description: This file contains a class 'Orleans3CompatibleStorageHashPicker' implementing an interface for selecting hashers in an Orleans storage context, specifically tailored for Orleans v3 to v7+ migration scenarios.

classes.name: Orleans3CompatibleStorageHashPicker
classes.description: A hash picker implementation for Orleans v3 compatibility within storage, capable of selecting appropriate hashers based on grain ID types.

methods.name: Orleans3CompatibleStorageHashPicker
methods.description: Constructor initializing the hasher for non-string keys and the collection of hash providers.

methods.name: PickHasher
methods.description: Selects an appropriate hasher based on grain ID type, returning a special hasher for integer or GUID keys, or creating a new string key hasher otherwise.
